verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides multiple official SDKs developers can build against on this GPU, including the CUDA Toolkit (compiler, runtime, libraries), CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python, RTX Neural Shaders SDK, and Video Codec SDK, all first-party and documented for AI/graphics development. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of building against these SDKs, and no agent-specific SDK examples beyond generic 'agentic AI' marketing language.
